verdict.rationale: Twenty can be driven without its UI. It offers REST and GraphQL endpoints with role-scoped API keys, a Metadata API for programmatic schema changes, unlimited API import for automation, outgoing webhooks and webhook-triggered workflows. It also has a CLI (create-twenty-app, twenty app:publish, dev) and a single-command Docker Compose install, all of which could be scripted. However, nothing documents running it in CI pipelines, and the CLI shown is for app development rather than general automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage docs, non-interactive CLI authentication for pipelines, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
